einzeiler: Gloria Steinem's legacy, Raven-Symoné's comments, and the conviction in Tupac's murder…
kurzfassung: The hosts discuss the passing of feminist icon Gloria Steinem and examine the ongoing debate surrounding Raven-Symoné's remarks about her Disney show. They also review Stephen A. Smith's defense of Jay-Z regarding Colin Kaepernick and the recent murder conviction in the Tupac Shakur trial. Finally, they touch upon the tragic death of a young Haitian immigrant in Ohio and share personal college fraternity memories.
stichpunkte: Tribute to pioneering feminist journalist and activist Gloria Steinem following her passing at age 92
Analysis of Raven-Symoné's controversial comments regarding the cultural identity of her show 'That's So Raven'
Stephen A. Smith's remarks on the relationship between Colin Kaepernick, Jay-Z, and the NFL workout fallout
Discussion on the tragic death of 20-year-old Haitian immigrant Pierre Damas Bell in Springfield, Ohio
Personal reflections on college marching band rivalries and Van Latham's fraternity history
A Las Vegas jury convicting Dwayne Keefee Davis of first-degree murder in the 1996 killing of Tupac Shakur
Exploration of the culture of drill rap and the pressures of retaliation within the genre

clips.hook: Decades later, a verdict in a legendary murder case
clips.text: A jury reached a swift verdict nearly thirty years after the fatal shooting of a rap icon.

beschreibung:
Today on Higher Learning, Van and Rachel talk about the passing of Gloria Steinem, Stephen A. Smith’s continued feud with Colin Kaepernick, and Raven-Symoné’s recent comments about the Blackness of 'That’s So Raven.' Plus, 20-year-old Pierre Damas Bel dies by suicide, reportedly out of fears of deportation, eight Democrats vote alongside Republicans to condemn socialism, and friend of the show Geno Smith makes a surprise phone appearance and spills the tea on Van’s fraternity life. Then, they talk trials and the guilty verdict in Tupac’s murder, and Lil Durk gets snitched on.
